description: SMTP BO test inherits Local mailer adapter even in production where local storage is disabled; deliver exits and kills LiveView. Use SMTP for configured SMTP test and render delivery failures without crashing. Add regression tests. Action reuse: local-only existing mailer delivery; no new operation or agent tool. Existing docker-compose.yml modifications are out of scope.

comments.text: Action reuse assessment: affected operation is the existing BO SMTP test send via Zaq.Mailer.deliver/2; production SMTP sender lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex already selects Swoosh.Adapters.SMTP for channel delivery, but is channel-specific and not an appropriate BO call. Decision: local-only adapter selection correction in existing BO test path; no new Action/agent exposure. Inputs: saved enabled SMTP config + recipient, outputs: status or user-visible failure; delivery remains a single attempt using Swoosh and existing auth/config, no new permission boundary. Verification: LiveView tests for Local->SMTP and exit recovery; isolated suite 31/31, mix q and strict Credo pass. Full E2E attempt timed out after 5min; final review/precommit gates pending.

Follow-up: BO test now constructs Outgoing and dispatches existing :deliver_outgoing event to Channels, reusing the same EmailBridge.send_reply/SmtpSender path as production notifications. Deleted duplicate BO SMTP option, sender, TLS and delivery-password code. Action reuse: reuse existing Channels event/bridge/sender rather than local-only SMTP operation; no new Action, no agent tool exposure. Removed four BO-only decrypt-failure tests whose old UI-only behavior diverged from production sender; replaced with delegation regression and real SMTP sender integration test. Tests: isolated LiveView + SMTP sender 62 passed; mix q and strict Credo pass; existing system_config E2E 183 passed. Full E2E suite remains unverified (previous five-minute timeout).

title: [BUG] Fix SMTP test delivery adapter and LiveView crash
